notes: Mr. Smiley's, 'Smile! You're at Mr. Smiley's!', Smiley sauce, Janine's turf, pass the asparagus, the 1970 Pontiac Firebird, 'I will sell this house today', the dancing bag and Red Lobster on Thursdays are all on Wikiquote. Taste flag, not a fact flag: 'Angela's Thursday nights at Red Lobster' comes from Angela's speech about men staring at her since she was twelve, and the rose petal sundae is Lester's fantasy about a 16-year-old. Look flags: the menu header still is cropped so only Carolyn's apron and rose show, no face; the name badge reads 'Mr. Smiley's.' with a full stop instead of a name.

vibe.verdict: Mr. Smiley's drive-thru with Smiley sauce, the asparagus and the Firebird works, but two lines lean on the Angela fantasy and the poster plus a headless header still carry the look.
